title: WalletUX
tagline: Ever wondered what wallet has the best UX? I created a wallet rating dashboard for that
description: In this project I (a professional UX designer) reviewed multiple wallet apps and analysed their design patterns, strengths, weaknesses and unique features. A website dashboard has been created to rank the wallets based on product quality and features offered to end users. Wallet teams can come to the website and read the feedback to implement improvements as well as see what offerings competitors have.
how_its_made: For analysis I downloaded each wallet and sent little ETH to it, then made screenshots and notes during testing. To build the website I used v0.dev tool. As I am a designer not dev, I needed vibe coding tool to do the coding for me. Vercel has been used to create live version of the website which is cool.
